record.title: Polyhedra with Vertex-Factored Fantappiè Denominators
record.statement: Give a geometric characterization of compact polyhedra $P$ whose Fantappiè-transform denominator is $\Omega(u)=\prod_{v\in V(P)}(1-\langle v,u\rangle)$.
